title: Quick Crunchy Italian Shank Cacio e Pepe
description: A nutty, crunchy twist on the classic Italian dish, featuring hind shank in a light miso-marinate, perfect for low-carb diets.
instructions: Season the hind shank pieces with salt and set aside.
In a large bowl, whisk together miso paste, garlic, and olive oil until smooth.
Add the hind shank pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the miso marinade.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Remove the hind shank pieces from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
Place the hind shank on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the hind shank in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until browned and caramelized.
While the hind shank is roasting, combine pesto and parmesan cheese in a small bowl.
After the hind shank has roasted for 15 minutes, brush the pesto-parmesan mixture evenly over the top.
Return the hind shank to the oven and continue roasting for an additional 5-10 minutes, or until the pesto is lightly browned and crispy.
Remove the hind shank from the oven and sprinkle with black pepper and parsley.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
